Music — preparation batch, October 14, 2026
Not yet imported, wired or auditioned in Unity (unverified).

==============================================================================
1) MenuTheme.ogg, InvestigationLoop.ogg, InvestigationLoop_Calm.ogg
==============================================================================
Composer / performer: John Bartmann (https://johnbartmann.com)
Album: "100 Ambient Atmospheric Soundtracks: Straylight Drones Collection"
       (published on the Free Music Archive, March 2, 2021)
Album page: https://freemusicarchive.org/music/John_Bartmann/100-ambient-atmospheric-soundtracks-straylight-drones-collection

  Shipped file                 Source track (title as published)
  MenuTheme.ogg                "profound-mystery-master"
  InvestigationLoop.ogg        "a-wall-of-glass-master"
  InvestigationLoop_Calm.ogg   "background-scan-master"

License: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Redistribution, modification and commercial use permitted; attribution not required.

How the license was checked (October 14, 2026):
- The Free Music Archive album page states that the album's songs are licensed under
  "CC0 1.0 Universal" (album released March 2, 2021; the page notes that individual
  tracks carry their own license field).
- FMA track pages of the same album that could be read (broken-suspense-master,
  ominous-night-master, ice-crystal-harp-master, ethereal-moments-master,
  dark-highway-master, back-to-bali-master, back-to-the-mountain-master,
  bee-hive-pad-master) each state "CC0 1.0 Universal".
- The composer's own store listing for the same collection
  (https://johnbartmann.gumroad.com/l/tHThs) describes the soundtracks as Creative
  Commons CC0 (public domain): usable without written permission, commercially or
  non-commercially, in all territories and media.
- The track pages of the three exact tracks were not individually readable from the
  build environment (freemusicarchive.org is not reachable here; the pages were read
  through a web search service). The files' embedded ID3 tags (artist and composer
  "John Bartmann", album "100 Ambient Atmospheric Soundtracks", comment
  "https://johnbartmann.com") match the album. If you want per-track certainty, open
  the three track pages under the album URL above and confirm the CC0 field.
- The composer made the album with the Native Instruments "Straylight" sound library.
  That library's licence governs the composer's use of the instrument; the published
  recordings are his work, dedicated to the public domain by him.

Download channel: the CC0 music mirror https://github.com/SoundSafari/CC0-1.0-Music
(repository licence CC0 1.0), commit 655388f987eacf6d08d73080fcc3e727f267bfde,
folder "freemusicarchive.org/". Original MP3s (320 kbps, 48 kHz stereo) and their
SHA-256 are listed in sources.json. The originals are not shipped (10 MB each).

Changes made by the project (Source~/build_loops.py, reproducible):
- Cut one musical period of each track as a seamless loop:
  MenuTheme: 120.000 s from source 67.5 s; the second pass of the 8-chord, 120 s
  progression is not a sample copy, so the seam uses a 6 s raised-cosine crossfade
  (match correlation 0.94); the loop is rotated so the file begins on the chord change
  at source 119.9 s.
  InvestigationLoop: 104.000 s from source 30.0 s; the source repeats sample-exactly
  every 104 s (correlation 1.000), so no crossfade was needed.
  InvestigationLoop_Calm: 128.000 s from source 80.0 s; sample-exact repeat in the
  source (correlation 1.000), no crossfade.
- Resampled 48 kHz -> 44.1 kHz with the SoX resampler, applied over the loop
  circularly so the seam stays clean.
- Static gain only (no compression/limiting): MenuTheme -18 LUFS, both investigation
  loops -20 LUFS integrated, true peak at or below -1.5 dBTP.
- Encoded OGG Vorbis quality 6, stereo, 44.1 kHz; metadata and cover art stripped.

Voluntary credit (suggested for the demo's credits/settings screen):
  Music: "profound-mystery", "a-wall-of-glass" and "background-scan" by John Bartmann
  (johnbartmann.com), from "100 Ambient Atmospheric Soundtracks: Straylight Drones
  Collection", CC0 1.0. Loops edited for this demo.
No endorsement by the composer is implied.

==============================================================================
2) ResetSting.ogg
==============================================================================
Original composition made for this project on October 14, 2026 (Claude, in this
asset-preparation batch) with Source~/compose_sting.py: pure numpy synthesis (additive
felt-piano chord, band-limited detuned pad, sine sub thud, inharmonic glass partials,
filtered noise, synthetic convolution reverb), fixed random seed 14102026. No samples,
recordings, presets or third-party material of any kind were used.
Project-owned. No third-party attribution or redistribution restrictions.

==============================================================================
3) Source~/ (ignored by Unity)
==============================================================================
audio_util.py, build_loops.py, compose_sting.py and loops_report.json were written for
this project (project-owned). Re-running them on the sources listed in sources.json
reproduces the pre-encode PCM of all four files exactly (checked October 14, 2026).
